name: ucminf
title: Quasi-Newton minimization with BFGS updates of the inverse Hessian.

origin.description: Quasi-Newton minimization with BFGS updates of the inverse Hessian.
origin.details: Quasi-Newton minimization with BFGS updates of the inverse Hessian.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ucminf))
fR <- function(x) (1 - x[1])^2 + 100 * (x[2] - x[1]^2)^2
gR <- function(x) c(-400 * x[1] * (x[2] - x[1] * x[1]) - 2 * (1 - x[1]),
                    200 * (x[2] - x[1] * x[1]))
ucminf(par = c(2, 0.5), fn = fR, gr = gR)
